nusmp.skill.grimoire_eyeball.description: Grimoire magic: Eyeball Magic. The mage manifests fleshy, veined eyes that float, turn and watch on their own and share what they see. The pages shoot eye bolts that slow, send hunting eyes, snipe moving targets, turn a gaze into stone, scan for magicules, swap places, share sight with allies, shoot down incoming spells, jam the magic of everyone the eyes can see, and open the Evil Eye of Catoblepas over a whole battlefield. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_eyeball.description: The grimoire of Eyeball Magic: twelve pages of eyes that are free of the face. Starters fire an eye bolt and a sniper shot that reads movement; mid pages send hunting eyes, petrify with a gaze, scan magicules through walls, swap places with a foe, share sight with allies, circle you as guardians and leave scouting eyes behind; the zone page is a Jamming Gaze Field that silences everyone the eyes can see (break line of sight to escape), the signature is Catoblepas's Evil Eye, and the daily is a Swarm of Eyes. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eyeball_strike: An eye tears loose from the air and flies at the enemy, trailing red veins. It flies 22 blocks, pierces every foe on its line for 8 damage scaled by Existence Points, and slows each one (Slowness I) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.sniper_eye: One eye hangs far ahead, watching the muscles of the prey, and fires when the step is already decided. Hits the first target within 40 blocks instantly for 8 damage, or 12 if it is moving or falling, and slows it (Slowness I) for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.roving_eyes: Four small eyes slip from the grimoire and wander after the nearest enemies. Fires 4 homing eyes that deal 5 damage each on hit and apply Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.petrifying_gaze: A stare that does not blink turns the blood to stone. The first target within 22 blocks takes 3 damage and is paralysed for up to 3.5 seconds, with Slowness X, no jumping and Mining Fatigue for 2 more seconds. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock, shortened by repeats, a quarter on bosses.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.magicule_scan: The eyes spread out like a net and read every magicule signature around you. Every enemy within 20 blocks (up to 16) glows through walls for 10 seconds and loses 3 percent of its magicules (0.5 percent on bosses). You gain Night Vision for 12 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.eye_swap: You see through the eye on the enemy, and for a breath that is where you stand. You and the target within 20 blocks trade places; it takes 2 damage, is blinded for 2 seconds, slowed (Slowness II) for 3 seconds and forgets its aim. Fails without room on both sides and never works on bosses.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.sight_share: Your eyes become everyone's eyes. You and allies within 16 blocks (up to 8) gain Night Vision for 60 seconds and Speed I for 30 seconds, and every enemy within 30 blocks glows for 10 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.guardian_eyes: Eyes circle you, blinking, and nothing slips past them. For 10 seconds enemy projectiles and spells entering 4 blocks are shot down (up to 24), you gain Resistance I, and enemies near you are slowed (Slowness II) every half second.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.scouting_eyes: You leave eyes in the air and walk away, still watching through them. For 25 seconds a 14 block circle at your aim point makes every enemy inside glow and be weakened (Weakness I), and gives allies inside Night Vision.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.jamming_gaze_fie: A great eye opens above a circle of ground and nothing under it may cast. For 10 seconds, every half second, enemies within 6 blocks (up to 12) take 2 damage and Slowness III; those the eye can see (no wall between) are also silenced and have their Ultimate skills jammed. Break line of sight to avoid the jamming.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.catoblepas_s_evi: Eyes spread over the whole field and the prey is read: its magic, its stamina, its next step. For 10 seconds, every second the 5 nearest enemies within 20 blocks are revealed and sniped for 5 damage (7.5 if moving), slowed (Slowness II) and bled of 1 percent of their magicules. On the last pulse they are paralysed for up to 2.5 seconds. Hard control: shares the 12 second control lock. You gain Night Vision.
nusmp.page.book_eyeball.swarm_of_eyes: A cloud of tiny eyes flies around you, and each one finds a victim. For 12 seconds, five times a second, one eye picks a random enemy within 22 blocks for 3 damage and Slowness I. Once a day.
